description.value: Salt Spring Island Multi Space (SIMS) is a government-operated community recreation facility run by SSIPARC (Salt Spring Island Parks, Arts, Recreation & Culture), a service of the Capital Regional District. The facility offers drop-in gym programs, aquatics, roller-skating, pickleball, kindergym, and a broad range of community programs across all age groups. For a touring cyclist arriving by ferry to Salt Spring Island, SIMS represents one of the island's primary public recreation hubs.
